page0.text:
When I awake, the sun is already up.
My room is dimly lit.
I feel like it's still last night, but I quickly shake my head to banish the thought.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page0:1

page1.text:
"It's cloudy outside. No wonder I didn't wake up."
The added darkness seems to have done a lot to help my sleep-deprived body get some actual rest.
A glance at the clock tells me it's past one in the afternoon.
I'm way past the point of oversleeping.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page1:1

page2.text:
"Saber, are you awake?"
...
There's no answer.
Saber is still next to me, slightly curled and still asleep.
Once I'm not sleepy anymore, I wake up, but Saber has to recover her magical energy. Considering how much she's slept in the past, I doubt she'll wake up until later in the afternoon.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page2:1

page3.text:
I leave my room without waking Saber.
There's no reason to wake her.
The real danger is at night.
There's no way Lancer or Gilgamesh will appear while the sun's still out.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page3:1

page4.text:
"..."
So we need to come up with a plan.
I don't know about Lancer, but Gilgamesh will definitely show up tonight.
Given his personality, and the murderous look he gave us before he left yesterday, we can definitely expect him tonight.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page4:1

page5.text:
But what should we do?
He has an infinite supply of Noble Phantasms, and one of them is stronger than Excalibur.
Berserker was a hard enemy to defeat, but we still managed.
We managed to find and exploit a chance to turn the tide against him.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page5:1

page6.text:
Not this guy.
If he showed up now, it wouldn't even be a contest.
One blow from that Noble Phantasm, Ea, and we're finished.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page6:1

page7.text:
"I need to think of something. There's not much time until the sun sets."
There won't be an end to this if I think on my own.
If Saber, Tohsaka, and I can't think of a plan, then—
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page7:1

page8.text:
"The church. Maybe that overseer priest might know something."
He might have a plan that could help us deal with the mess we're in.
The King of Heroes, Gilgamesh.
Kotomine said he would find some way to deal with this Servant who survived the previous Holy Grail War.
Even if we can't think of a countermeasure, Kotomine might have already thought of something.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page8:1

page9.text:
I walk up the hill.
The sky is blanketed with ash-gray clouds.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page9:1

page10.text:
...
The church sits alone at the top of the hill.
There's nobody there, and not a sound to be heard. Not even birds chirping.
Maybe that's because it's so gloomy out?
The place looks more ominous than holy.
It looks like an execution site.
I walk up the long hill and cross the wide open square, ready to be judged for my sins and cast down into hell.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page10:1

page11.text:
"The hell am I talking about? That's no metaphor."
Besides, the church is a place where people die.
Hospitals work to prolong a person's life, but plenty of people die there.
Churches are like that too.
In that sense, death hangs heavy over this place.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page11:1

page12.text:
...
The wind's cold.
I pull up my collar and climb the church's stairs.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page12:1

page13.text:
"Kotomine. I came to talk to you."
I step into the chapel.
Just like the square, there's nobody here.
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page13:1

page14.text:
"Kotomine?"
He might be in the back.
I pass through the pews and walk towards the altar.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page14:1

page15.text:
Tap, tap, tap.
A dry sound echoes through the chapel.
The building is probably designed to make sounds echo, but the sound of my lonely footsteps is haunting in this huge, empty space.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page15:1

page16.text:
"Kotomine? Are you here?"
I call softly to the priest.
This is ridiculous.
If I want an answer, I should be shouting.
He's probably in the back, so he won't hear me unless I shout.
But I don't. I keep quiet, tiptoeing my way to the back of the church.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page16:1

page17.text:
Am I doing this so that I don't mess with the solemn air of the chapel?
Or because I feel like, if I'm spotted, I'll be surrounded by things I don't understand, and then maybe get beheaded for defiling God or something?
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page17:1

page18.text:
I exit the chapel and head to the courtyard.
"If I remember correctly, Kotomine's room is..."
I walk more quietly down the corridor.
The church is like a labyrinth, and I don't know how to find Kotomine's room.
My memory's kind of hazy, and I'm sure I won't be able to find it on my own.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page18:1

page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page19:1

page20.text:
There's something...
I slow my breathing.
It's hard to breathe. My throat is parched.
I don't know why...
...but beads of sweat begin forming on my forehead, though the corridor itself is chilly.
I use all of my senses to try to get a feel for my surroundings.
I do so...
But I'm not sure why.
Why am I walking so quietly? Why is my heart beating so fast? Why—
Why do I have such a bad feeling about this place?
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page20:1

page21.text:
...
Two words repeat over and over in my mind.
Go back, go back, go back, go back.
Kotomine's not here, so you have no reason to stay. You're alone. You should go home. This is a mistake. It shouldn't be so cold. It's all wrong. Go back, go back, go back.
Go back. For your own sake, go back. There's nothing bad happening here. This place is—there's nothing happening in this church, so go home!
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page21:1

page22.text:
"Hn...gh!"
I feel nauseous.
I think I might throw up.
My intuition is always right about these kinds of things.
For an untrained mage, I have a pretty good danger sense.
Which is why my feet don't stop.
I try to get my racing heart under control as I search for Kotomine's room.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page22:1

page23.text:
And then I run into a deep darkness.
"There's a...basement?"
I spot a set of stairs.
In the deep shadows, I see a recess that I'd normally overlook. In it, I see a very, very narrow staircase.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page23:1

page24.text:
...
I shouldn't go down.
I can bet...
Kotomine won't be there.
There won't be anyone down there.
There's...nothing there.
There won't be any cor...
There won't be any...ses.
There won't be any...p...
I shouldn't go in there!
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十五日目-00:page24:1
